purpose: Teach: 渦/大雪/鮨/呪文/電灯/コンセント/キノコ/ハンバーガー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、海で渦に巻き込まれそうになっただろ?
lines.en: Riku — you almost got pulled into a whirlpool at the beach, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful accusation with a knowing grin. Quick attack on the opening. Leaning forward slightly, testing him. Light, probing tone — she's enjoying catching him off-guard.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、大雪で学校休みになって喜んでただろ、桜
lines.en: You were thrilled when heavy snow cancelled school, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry deflection, mirror-image counter. Flat delivery on the opening, then a slight smirk underneath. Not defensive — just turning her own game back on her with quiet amusement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で鮨屋行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku — didn't your family go to that sushi place?
lines.style: Pressing forward, undeterred. Casual, observant tone. She's watching to see if he'll admit it. Small smile playing at the corners — she knows something he doesn't think she knows.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ファンタジー小説で呪文唱えてんな、桜
lines.en: You sit there reading fantasy novels like you're actually casting spells, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft jab wrapped in affection. Slow, deliberate delivery — he's taking his time with this one. Not mean. The tone of someone who notices everything and chooses what to say carefully.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、古い電灯まだ使ってんの?
lines.en: Riku — your house still has those old lights, right?
lines.style: Curious but needling. Shorter breath on the opening. She's circling around something — testing whether he'll rise to it or just let her in. Warm underneath the teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、コンセント抜くの忘れんなよ、桜
lines.en: Make sure you actually unplug the outlet this time, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet concern hidden inside dry instruction. Spoken matter-of-fact, but there's something protective underneath — he's checking on her safety without making it obvious. Almost reluctant care.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、山でキノコ狩り好きだろ?
lines.en: You like foraging for mushrooms in the mountains, don't you?
lines.style: Returning to the rhythm, lighter now. Quick tempo, straightforward curiosity. She's dropped the needling for a moment — genuine question, still wrapped in the same teasing wrapper.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、放課後にハンバーガー食ってんな、桜
lines.en: You're eating hamburgers after school again, Sakura.
lines.style: Final callback, affectionate exhaustion. Slower close. The tone of someone who's given up pretending he doesn't notice or care. Warm resignation — she does what she does, and he knows it.
